description: This file implements the WifiManager scanning functionality, handling asynchronous Wi-Fi network scans, event registration, JSON parsing of SSID lists, filtering, and interaction with the IARM bus for wireless network information retrieval.

classes.name: WifiManagerScan
classes.description: Implements Wi-Fi scanning functionalities, including starting/stopping scans, handling events, and filtering SSID lists.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Registers event handlers for Wi-Fi SSID availability events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters event handlers for Wi-Fi SSID availability events.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Begins a Wi-Fi scan based on provided parameters; delegates to incremental or full scan methods.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously requests the list of available SSIDs from the network manager.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsyncIncr
methods.description: Starts an incremental asynchronous scan, providing partial results in stages.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Stops a currently running incremental Wi-Fi scan.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles IARM bus events related to Wi-Fi SSID list availability and applies filtering before notifying the main WifiManager.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters the SSID list based on regex pattern and frequency as specified in the filter.
